# Promoted to repo memory: typed-judge

Cite these in .sofar/repo.md by qualified handle — `typed-judge M<n>` —
which is how `sofar doctor` sees that a promoted fact reached repo memory.

- **M1** (2026-09-22T08:31:44.233Z) — Staging by explicit path is NOT enough in this shared worktree. Every concurrent session shares ONE git index, so a peer's plain `git commit` (no pathspec) commits whatever anyone has staged.
Observed 2026-09-22: typed-judge staged its 4.2/4.3 files, and sofar-1b's `record: drive-visibility …` commit (d0ebec9) landed between that `git add` and typed-judge's `git commit`, taking all 13 files under drive-visibility's message and attribution.
Fix: commit with a pathspec, `git commit -F <msgfile> -- <path> <path>…`. It commits exactly those paths whatever else is staged, and leading with git keeps the record exemption (repo-memory-capture M2).
Symptom: your `git commit` says "no changes added to commit" right after a successful `git add`, and `git show --stat HEAD` shows your files in a peer's commit.
